goal: Create a timeline diagram with a mixed perspective of WeChat Pay JSAPI/Native, highlighting the synchronous calls and notify_url callbacks among the merchant system, WeChat Pay platform, and WeChat mobile client.

canvas.background: deep slate #0F172A with subtle 1px grid #1E293B at 32px spacing

title_strip.title: WeChat Pay · unified order to notify
title_strip.subtitle: mchid 1900006XXX · H5/public account scene
title_strip.position: top-left, JetBrains Mono / SF Mono, light gray

header_box_style.size: 160px wide × 64px tall, all headers identical size, evenly spaced
header_box_style.label: actor name in mono 11pt + small icon glyph above name

lifelines.rule: Draw a vertical dashed line lifeline below each actor header

items.label: 1. POST /checkout session { sku_id, openid, amount: 19900, currency: CNY }
2. Generate out_trade_no, attach, notify_url idempotent key
3. POST /v3/pay/transactions/jsapi Authorization: WECHATPAY2-SHA256... body { mchid, appid, out_trade_no, description, amount{total}, payer{openid} }
5. 200 { timeStamp, nonceStr, package: prepay_id=..., signType, paySign } to H5/JS
8. POST notify_url? Signature X-Wechatpay-Signature, body { out_trade_no, transaction_id, trade_state: SUCCESS }
9. 200 response { code: SUCCESS } (must be within 5 seconds)
10. Front-end polling or WebSocket receives order_status=PAID

message_style.sync: solid line 1.5px slate #94A3B8, filled triangle arrowhead at target
message_style.async: solid line 1.5px slate #94A3B8, hollow triangle arrowhead
message_style.return: dashed line 1.5px slate #64748B, hollow triangle arrowhead

messages.label_format: Number + message summary, including key HTTP/field names

activation_bars.rule: Merchant backend drawing activation bar in the request processing segment with pay API

notes.rule: Side Note on M3: mTLS/Platform Certificate and APIv3 Key Used for Signature Verification and Encrypting Sensitive Fields

loops_alts.rule: alt box: notify retry and query single compensation

legend.content: Sync vs return vs notify(callback); external actor is slate

must_keep: Messages time sequence from top to bottom
